title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Integer Overflow via OgreBinarySerializer::ReadSubMesh
description: CVE-2026-129479 is an integer overflow vulnerability in Assimp version 4.0, specifically in the OgreBinarySerializer::ReadSubMesh component. The vulnerability was published on November 16, 2026. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no patch or remediation details are available from the vendor.
